calibration.note: Report-only budgets at 3x the first calibration run's p50 (O-CEO-9). Written by `bun run test:scale -- --calibrate`. PGLite is calibrated on its first run after F4b (planner-stats ANALYZE): before it, PGLite p50s measure un-analyzed plans (get_health ~12 s at 10k).
